newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 21.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's Daily Variety:
* Sony 's "Men in Black" zapped an estimated $19 million over the weekend, becoming the first film of the summer to rule the fickle box office universe for three consecutive frames.
* In a wide-ranging state-of-the-biz session with reporters Sunday, studio TV chieftains sounded the alarm on rising costs for inexperienced talent.
* Less glitz, more art, a raft of U.S. indies and an almost total dearth of big U.S. studio releases marks the lineup of the 54th Venice Intl.
* Trimark Pictures is expected to announce Monday that it has retained investment bankers Societe Generale Bannon to advise it on strategic alliances or a possible sale.
* Fox Broadcasting Co. is Monday expected to name Gary Hoffman senior VP of made-for-TV movies and miniseries, a post he held at Fox once before from 1993 to 1995.
* Bertelsmann Music Group posted record revenue of $4.4 billion for the fiscal year 1996-97, which included record profits in both its international and domestic operations.
